reply_text:
I posted a reply to you in this DM. I can't set up the recurring 09:00 digest. I can post a Coastal team digest of #coastal-team on request here, starting with what's new since your last check.

One correction to my DM: I said I have no scheduler, but I didn't check the cron option. Cron jobs created from this session run locally and their output isn't delivered back here, so a scheduled digest wouldn't reach you reliably. Ask if you want me to try that anyway.
